Container.Name: nanosaur-mobile
Container.Overview: Pangea Software's Nanosaur (1998) in the browser: WebAssembly build of Iliyas Jorio's modern source with touch controls, a compact HUD and offline PWA support. Serve it over HTTPS (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager) so phones can install it and play offline.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the game is served on

Config.Name: Arcade address
Config.Description: Address of your au12 Arcade (https://arcade.example.com). Lets the arcade show this game and receive its scores. Leave empty for no arcade.
